study.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] [CONTAMINATED_TTP — used as CRBSI definition criterion] DTP >2h was used as a diagnostic criterion for the conservative method of CR-BSI diagnosis, not as a measured prognostic variable. No continuous TTP values reported. Mortality reported for diagnostic-method groups (standard vs conservative) rather than TTP groups. Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-25.

population.pathogen_species: Gram-negative bacilli 43.4% (Acinetobacter, Pseudomonas, Klebsiella, Enterobacter); Fungi 35.9% (Candida albicans, non-albicans); Gram-positive cocci 20.7% (CoNS, MSSA, E. faecalis)
population.empiric_abx_definition: antibiotic therapy administered within 24h after blood culture samples obtained to which the microorganism was susceptible
population.incubation_protocol: BD BACTEC 9240 system, up to 5 days; conservative method used paired blood cultures CVC vs peripheral with DTP >2h
population.notes: All adult ICU patients with CR-BSI; mean APACHE II at bacteremia 15.43±4.52; 75% mechanical ventilation; 70% septic shock

ttp.notes: DTP (differential time to positivity) >2h used as criterion for conservative CR-BSI diagnosis; absolute/continuous TTP not reported. 16 cases diagnosed by conservative method (DTP >2h); 37 by standard catheter-tip culture method.

outcomes.outcome_definition: In-hospital mortality 33/53 (62.2%) overall; 21/37 (57%) standard method vs 12/16 (75%) conservative method (p=0.208); not stratified by TTP
outcomes.notes: OR is for conservative vs standard diagnostic method, not TTP exposure; reported here descriptively

outcomes.outcome_definition: ICU mortality 29/53 (54.7%); 17/37 standard (46%) vs 12/16 conservative (75%) p=0.051
outcomes.notes: Comparison by diagnostic method, not TTP

study.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] TTP median+IQR and TTP<20h cutpoint reported with 30/90-day mortality and persistent bacteremia rates, but outcomes stratified by single vs multiple set positive blood cultures rather than TTP. Small cohort (n=49 total; n=41 treated). Cutpoint of 20h applied descriptively. Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-25. First author listed as Sasaki; corresponding author/PI Doi.

population.incubation_protocol: versaTREK (Thermo) through mid-2018; BACTEC FX (BD) thereafter; aerobic and anaerobic incubation
population.notes: Charlson median 2 [IQR 1-3]; methicillin-resistant 26.8%; SIRS 85.4%; primary BSI 46.3%, catheter-related 36.6%. 8 additional patients not treated with antimicrobials separately described. Analysis cohort n=41.

ttp.notes: TTP <20h in 17/41 (41.5%). Median TTP 22h single-positive vs 20h multiple-positive (p=0.426). Cutpoint of 20h applied descriptively in paper without ROC derivation.

outcomes.outcome_definition: 30-day all-cause mortality 6/41 (14.6%); not stratified by TTP. Reported by single (4/30=13.3%) vs multiple positive (2/11=18.2%), p=0.651
outcomes.notes: Overall 30-day mortality 14.6% (6/41); not stratified by TTP cutpoint

outcomes.outcome_definition: 90-day all-cause mortality 13/41 (31.7%); not stratified by TTP. Single 11/30 (36.7%) vs multiple 2/11 (18.2%), p=0.393
Persistent bacteremia 3/41 (7.3%); single 1/30 (3.3%) vs multiple 2/11 (18.2%), p=0.17

study.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] [CONTAMINATED_TTP — used as enrollment criterion AND pre/post device exposure variable] First-in-human prospective multicenter non-randomized interventional safety study of Seraph 100 hemoperfusion device in hemodialysis patients with BSI. TTP used as inclusion criterion (TTP <14h OR DTP between catheter and peripheral) and as pre/post-device pathogen load surrogate, NOT as prognostic exposure. Mortality 0/15 over 14-day follow-up. Funded by ExThera Medical. Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-25.

population.pathogen_species: S. aureus n=9, S. epidermidis n=2, E. coli n=1, E. faecalis n=2, K. pneumoniae n=1
population.empiric_abx_definition: all patients on antibiotic therapy at enrollment; specific empiric appropriateness not assessed
population.incubation_protocol: Standard hospital BC system; cultures drawn pre/post Seraph 100 filter at 5,30,60,120,180,240 min during treatment
population.notes: All chronic hemodialysis patients (median dialysis vintage 28 months); vascular access: tunneled catheter n=9, acute catheter n=4, AV fistula n=3. Seraph 100 treatment started median 66.4h [45.7-80.6] after initial positive BC. NCT02914132.

ttp.notes: Inflow TTP median 18.96h [14.04-22.38] vs outflow 19.44h [14.36-23.78] (p=0.2). Median TTP increase 36 min [-7.2 to 96.3] between inflow and outflow blood cultures. Only 4/15 (26.7%) had positive BC at start of treatment; 52 paired BC measurements total. Inclusion required TTP <14h or DTP between catheter/peripheral.

outcomes.outcome_definition: 14-day all-cause mortality 0/15 (0%); all patients survived follow-up period
outcomes.notes: Primary endpoint was device safety; mortality was a follow-up observation only, not TTP-stratified

study.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Candidemia cohort with mean TTP by species and per-species mortality. TTP descriptively compared by species (not stratified for outcome); only time-to-appropriate-therapy was tested against survival (61.3h survivors vs 58.6h non-survivors, p=0.81). 19/115 excluded for early discharge (16.5% attrition). Pediatric patients included (~16% age <17). Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-25.

population.pathogen_species: Candida albicans 43 (44.8%); C. glabrata 27 (28.1%); C. parapsilosis 10; C. tropicalis 9; C. dubliniensis 3; C. lusitaniae 2; C. famata 1; C. krusei 1
population.empiric_abx_definition: fluconazole appropriate if dose >=400 mg/d (adjusted for renal function); inappropriate if used for C. krusei or after C. glabrata identified
population.incubation_protocol: BACT/Alert Microbial Detection System (bioMerieux); 2 aerobic fan bottles up to 10 mL each; routine held 5 days, fungal cultures held 21 days
population.notes: 355-bed teaching hospital. 94.7% had CVC; 28.1% TPN; 24% diabetes; 32.3% recent surgery; 9.4% immunosuppressed. ICU LOS mean 14.4±18.2d before BC. Pediatric: neonate 0, infant 5, toddler 3, child 7 = 15 (15.6%) pediatric.

ttp.notes: TTP reported by Candida species only (not overall): C. albicans 35.3±18.1h; C. glabrata 80.0±22.4h (p<0.0001); C. parapsilosis 37.3±17.0; C. tropicalis 26.2±11.1; C. dubliniensis 39.2±18.1; C. lusitaniae 28.7±13.5; C. famata 26.6; C. krusei 28.6. See arm-specific entries below for species-stratified data.

outcomes.outcome_definition: In-hospital mortality 28/96 (29.2%); not stratified by TTP. Per species: C. albicans 10/43 (23.3%); C. glabrata 8/27 (29.6%); C. parapsilosis 0/10; C. tropicalis 6/9 (66.7%). Time to appropriate therapy not associated with survival (58.6±40.0h non-survivors vs 61.3h survivors, p=0.81)
outcomes.notes: Mortality not stratified by TTP; only by species. Time to appropriate therapy (not TTP) tested vs survival.

study.notes: [INCLUSIVE_ONLY] Brucellosis cohort; exposure modeled as bacteremia status (not TTP). Bacteremic subgroup (n=62 Brucella-positive) has median TTP 3 days [IQR 2-3]. Outcomes (relapse, chronic brucellosis) reported but not stratified by TTP. Useful for fastidious-organism TTP distribution. Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-25.

population.empiric_abx_definition: doxycycline plus rifampicin most common (70%); 9% received other antimicrobials before BC collection
population.incubation_protocol: BacT/Alert 3D BioMerieux v.8; aerobic incubation at 37C with 5% CO2; subcultured on blood, chocolate, MacConkey, Thayer-Martin, Urea-slant media
population.notes: Acute brucellosis cases meeting CDC case definition. 146 included after exclusions; 62 (42%) bacteremic. Pediatric n=8 (5.4%) aged <15y. Acquired via raw dairy (90%) or animal aerosol exposure.

ttp.notes: TTP reported in days: mean 2.8 (SD 0.6) days, median 3 days [IQR 2-3]; all positive cultures detected within 3 days (72h) of incubation. Converted to hours: mean 67.2h (SD 14.4); median 72h [IQR 48-72]. Applies to 62 bacteremic patients only.

outcomes.outcome_definition: Relapsed brucellosis 13/129 (10.08%); 8/62 (12.9%) bacteremic vs 5/84 (5.95%) non-bacteremic; not stratified by TTP
outcomes.notes: OR is for bacteremia (not TTP) vs non-bacteremic comparison

outcomes.outcome_definition: Chronic brucellosis (symptoms + elevated IgG >1y post-acute infection) 9/129 (7%); 6/62 (9.6%) bacteremic vs 3/84 (5.7%) non-bacteremic. Adjusted OR for bacteremia (controlling for infection site and treatment) 7.25 (1.41-37.23), p=0.018
outcomes.notes: OR is for bacteremia status (not TTP); chronic brucellosis treated as relapse-type outcome here as enum has no 'chronic' category
